Name: Em's Pigs
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and ten colour options for the pigs. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
Including the pig, baby pig and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Yorkshire (light pink)
Wattle (dark red)
Oxford (red with spots)
Juliana (pink with spots)
Hampshire (black with white stripe)
Hog (brown)
Tamworth (red)
Berkshire (dark brown with white nose and legs)
Landrace (pink)
Boar (tusks)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Pigs CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a pig from Marnie, the type get's randomised and can be any of the ten options
If you rather choose which colour you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Pigs CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a config.json

The default is the [color=#e69138]Yorkshire[/color] pig. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] in the pig mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Yorkshire[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's shop icon
Save and close the file again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

Update 1.2 Both files can now be installed side by side[/i]
